text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, December's here in the blink 
of an eye. You worked hard this year.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for your hard work. 
Thanks to you, our hot spring town is 
gradually regaining its vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
And so...♪ Today marks a milestone, so let 
us take a good, restful break.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone, relax and let loose to 
your heart's content—!
